text:
omar: Heads-up: Iet the airline assigned me a middle seat on the red-eye. Anyone up for a magic window/middle swap? 62c
jin: Oof. I can trade if you let me nap across both seats like a narwhal. :sleeping: (jk, kinda)
riley: I always try to pick seats 24h before. Pro move: check the seat map again after check-in opens. People shuffle.
aurora: If you're close to the gate, ask the gate agent politely 30 mins before boarding. They usually move people around for families and aisle/window requests.
omar: I
m arriving at the gate super early (thanks, EWR traffic). Can also bribe with Trader Joehocolate. 
trip-bot: Flight UA412 updated: gate changed to B12. Boarding starts 22:10. https://www.united.com/flight/UA412 (double-check with airline app).
jin: Trader Joehocolate is a solid currency. Also, bring a laminated "will trade window for snacks" sign 609
riley: If you end up stuck in middle, swap with a parent traveling alone with a kid? Parents usually say yes.
aurora: PSA: Earplugs + eye mask = bliss for red-eyes. Also download a white-noise file onto phone in case Wi-Fi is flaky.
omar: Update: snagged a window! Guy agreed for two guilt-free chocolate bars. :tada: Thanks for the super practical tips.
jin: Victory snacks! :confetti_ball: Next time we should have a "seat swap fund" in the shared travel bag: granola bars + stickers.iley: Also, fun off-topic: airport meme - someone left a single flip-flop near gate B like itelongs to a long-lost soul. :shoe::laughing:
aurora: Please file photo in #random-memes.
omar: Posting evidence in 30. Thanks again, team. See you at the offsite!
